Usage:
  tok config -w <worker_id> [--set KEY VALUE]... [flags]

Examples:
  tokimeki config -w node01
  tokimeki config -w node01 --set compute-threads 2
  tokimeki config -w node01 --set compute-threads=4 --set manner-period=2h

Flags:
  -h, --help               help for config
      --json               print {compute_threads, manner_period_secs} as JSON
      --set stringArray    change a setting: KEY VALUE or KEY=VALUE (repeatable)
      --timeout duration   response timeout (default 30s)
  -w, --worker string      runner to configure

Global Flags:
      --base string   base directory for state (default: ~/.tokimeki)
      --verbose       print engine debug logs on stderr (warnings are always printed)
